recall_findings.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6. You are writing sections of a PRD for {product_name}.

Full outline:
{prd_outline}

Sections to draft in order:
1. Product Overview & Vision + Problem Statement
2. User Personas & Journey Maps
3. User Stories (grouped by persona)
4. Functional Requirements (MoSCoW prioritized)
5. Non-Functional Requirements + Technical Architecture Constraints
6. Milestones + Success Metrics + Risks

Reply with ONLY the section name for iteration {iteration}.

store_draft.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6 complete. Section written: {section_pick}

If iteration is less than 6, reply YES to continue. If iteration is 6, reply NO — all sections are drafted.
